typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	MercuryToCalypsoDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TYPE as string,
		REPORTDATE as timestamp,
		STRATEGY as string,
		PORTNAME as string,
		EXTACCOUNT as string,
		EXTPRODUCT as string,
		SYSTEMRECORD as string,
		RECONSTATUS as string,
		CALYPSOID as string,
		MERCURYTRADEPOSITION as decimal(38,8),
		CALYPSOPOSITION as decimal(38,8),
		POSITION_DIFF as decimal(38,8),
		ABSMERCURYTRADEPOSITION as decimal(38,8),
		ABSCALYPSOPOSITION as decimal(38,8),
		ABSPOSITION_DIFF as decimal(38,8),
		MERCURYTRADEMV as decimal(38,8),
		CALYPSOMV as decimal(38,8),
		MV_DIFF as decimal(38,8),
		MERCURYTRADEDTD as decimal(38,8),
		CALYPSODTD as decimal(38,8),
		DTD_DIFF as decimal(38,8),
		MERCURYTRADEYTD as decimal(38,8),
		CALYPSOYTD as decimal(38,8),
		YTD_DIFF as decimal(38,8)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> MercuryToCalypsoSource
MercuryToCalypsoSource derive(ToAddloadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> ToAddLoadDate
ToAddLoadDate sink(input(
		ExtProduct as string,
		ABSMercuryTradePosition as integer,
		MercuryTradeYTD as integer,
		Load_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ReportDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CalypsoID as string,
		PortName as string,
		Position_Diff as integer,
		ABSPosition_Diff as integer,
		DTD_Diff as integer,
		ReconStatus as string,
		CalypsoYTD as integer,
		MercuryTradePosition as integer,
		MercuryTradeMV as integer,
		TYPE as string,
		MercuryTradeDTD as integer,
		ExtAccount as string,
		MV_Diff as integer,
		ABSCalypsoPosition as integer,
		YTD_Diff as integer,
		CalypsoDTD as integer,
		CalypsoPosition as integer,
		Strategy as string,
		SystemRecord as string,
		CalypsoMV as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ExtProduct = EXTPRODUCT,
		ABSMercuryTradePosition = ABSMERCURYTRADEPOSITION,
		MercuryTradeYTD = MERCURYTRADEYTD,
		Load_Date = ToAddloadDate,
		ReportDate = REPORTDATE,
		CalypsoID = CALYPSOID,
		PortName = PORTNAME,
		Position_Diff = POSITION_DIFF,
		ABSPosition_Diff = ABSPOSITION_DIFF,
		DTD_Diff = DTD_DIFF,
		ReconStatus = RECONSTATUS,
		CalypsoYTD = CALYPSOYTD,
		MercuryTradePosition = MERCURYTRADEPOSITION,
		MercuryTradeMV = MERCURYTRADEMV,
		TYPE,
		MercuryTradeDTD = MERCURYTRADEDTD,
		ExtAccount = EXTACCOUNT,
		MV_Diff = MV_DIFF,
		ABSCalypsoPosition = ABSCALYPSOPOSITION,
		YTD_Diff = YTD_DIFF,
		CalypsoDTD = CALYPSODTD,
		CalypsoPosition = CALYPSOPOSITION,
		Strategy = STRATEGY,
		SystemRecord = SYSTEMRECORD,
		CalypsoMV = CALYPSOMV),
	partitionFileNames:[($MercuryToCalypsoDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> MercuryToCalypsoDestination
